what_this_is: H.264 encoder core of gpu/video/avc (bit writer, SPS/PPS/slice headers, 4x4 transform and quantisation incl. the Intra16x16 and chroma DC paths, CAVLC, Intra16x16 prediction with least-SAD mode choice, the macroblock layer with I_PCM fallback, the public encoder object with one slice per band of macroblock rows), plus -- after the lead replaced the linked core with avc2 on 11 Nov 04:00 -- WP03's contract test suite for avc2 through include/n2avc.h only.
done: avc/n2avc_bits.c: bit writer (ue/se/trailing/align/flush with an overflow flag) and n2avc_nal() with emulation_prevention_three_byte; the 00 00 00 00 00 01 -> 00 00 03 00 00 03 00 01 example passes.

avc/n2avc_ps.c: SPS (profile 66, constraint_set0+1, level from the table, crop units of 2, VUI video_signal_type/timing_info/bitstream_restriction exactly as include/n2avc.h specifies), PPS, and the slice header of clause 7.3.3 (I and P, IDR id alternating, dec_ref_pic_marking, disable_deblocking_filter_idc 1).

avc/n2avc_xform.c: forward 4x4 transform, MF/normAdjust quantisation, inverse quantisation and inverse transform per 8.5.12, Intra16x16 DC (Hadamard, qbits+2), chroma DC (2x2, qbits+1), QP_C table 8-15, SAD.

avc/n2avc_cavlc.c + avc/n2avc_tables.h: residual_block_cavlc with all five coeff_token classes, level_prefix/suffix with the suffixLength state machine, total_zeros (tables 9-7, 9-8, 9-9(a)), run_before (table 9-10, transmitted from the highest-frequency gap down), nC from the two neighbours (clause 9.2.1) incl. chroma DC nC = -1.
avc/n2avc_intra.c: Intra_16x16 vertical/horizontal/DC/plane with all availability cases, chroma DC per 4x4 block (8.3.4.1), horizontal/vertical/plane, least-SAD choice with deterministic ties.

avc/n2avc_mb.c: n2avc_intra_mb (mb_type table 7-11 with the +5 P offset, luma DC + AC in luma4x4BlkIdx order, chroma DC + AC, reconstruction, I_PCM fallback when a macroblock exceeds 3200 bits or overflows), n2avc_inter_residual / n2avc_write_inter_residual / n2avc_flush_skip_run / n2avc_cbp_inter_code (table 9-4 Inter column), n2avc_write_ipcm.

avc/n2avc_enc.c: n2avc_open/headers/encode/reconfigure/reconstruction/close with one RBSP buffer per slice, a persistent pthread pool created in open (threads == 1: no thread created), AVCC or Annex B packets, IDR on first picture/force_idr/keyint/INTRA_ONLY, border replication and rec/ref swap, calls into n2avc_rc_* and n2avc_inter_slice_begin/end + n2avc_p_mb as n2avc_int.h specifies.
avc/test/core/n2avc_cli.c: the CLI the oracle drives (--size/--frames/--qp|--bitrate/--keyint/--threads/--intra-only/--annexb/--nv12/--fps/--in/--out/--recon/--stats).
avc/test/core/stub_inter.c: the WP04 half of the seam for this suite (p_mb always returns 2, constant QP), so the P plumbing is exercised without WP04's files.

Tests: t_unit.c (9026 checks: ue/se bit strings, emulation prevention, every CAVLC table prefix-free and complete, the worked CAVLC block exactly '000010001110010111101101', transform round trips with hand-computed literals, table 9-4, table 8-15, nC), t_api.c (80 checks: argument errors, SPS parse, AVCC layout, force_idr, reconfigure, flat picture reconstructed exactly, NV12 == I420, I_PCM fallback is lossless), t_noalloc.c (allocator interposition), t_threads.c (4/16 slices under TSan), run_tests.sh (oracle: every stream decoded by ffmpeg is byte-identical to n2avc_reconstruction, 176x144/178x146/640x480 x QP 10/26/40/51 x 1/4 slices x intra/P, PSNR floors, trace_headers).

After the lead's reassignment: avc/test/core/t_avc2_api.c + run_avc2_tests.sh, the same contract checks against avc2/n2avc_core.c through n2avc.h only (117 API checks, TSan with 4 and 16 slices, no-allocation probe, 1000 pictures with frame_num wrap decoded by ffmpeg).
not_done: avc2 is not linked: the plug-in uses avc2/n2avc_core.c (lead's file); avc/n2avc_{bits,ps,xform,cavlc,intra,mb,enc}.c are kept but unused, as the lead instructed.
N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK (in-loop deblocking, stage 2 / R2) is not implemented: n2avc_open returns N2AVC_E_ARGUMENT, which the header allows.
The 4096x2304 configuration does not open in avc2 (level 5.1 MaxMBPS at 30 fps): reported to the lead, not fixed by me (avc2 is not my file). My own core opens and encodes it bit-exactly.
Bitrate mode (rate control) is WP04's; this suite always runs constant QP.
Nothing was run on the phone; no iOS object was produced from these files by me (WP01's build_ios.sh links avc2 now).

known_risks: The oracle proves bit-exactness for the sizes and QPs the suite runs; 4096x2304 was only checked with one picture of my core and does not open in avc2.
n2avc_encode returns N2AVC_E_OVERFLOW and marks the encoder failed when a picture does not fit the output buffer; no test reaches that path (the buffer is sized at 3x the raw picture).
The I_PCM fallback is decided by a 3200-bit budget, not by a rate-distortion comparison: a macroblock just under the budget costs more than I_PCM would.

Slice boundaries make pixels above a slice's first row 'not available' (clause 6.4.9), so the stream and the quality depend on the thread count; the oracle accepts both because it compares against the encoder's own reconstruction.
avc2's per-picture allocation (reported) means the camera path can block in malloc; not fixed here.
Everything above is host-tested only (x86-64 Linux, clang), never on the phone.
